summary.en: Conan, Haibara and the Detective Boys are going home from the hospital after visiting Agasa, who is still recovering from his injury. While Agasa is still in the hospital, her friends sometime come to her house to cheer her up after some emotional moments. More importantly, Yukiko also came back to cook for her at that time, so things are looking good for her. On their way home, they encounter a robber who is being chased by Detective Takagi. As the robber charges toward the boys, Haibara associates him as Gin chases her. Fortunately, Sato comes to the rescue in time, much to the admiration of the Detective Boys. Later, Takagi is about to write reports of the criminal’s arrest on his notebook, formerly belonging to Date, when he flips to the page containing character strings his senior wrote. These strings remind him of a case that both were trying to solve, a case that Date promised to make a man out of Takagi. Both of them were returning from a stakeout that, even though failed, did give them a paper containing character strings to decode. Suddenly, a car hit Date, leading to his death while Takagi witnessed in horror.
